requirements.text: Real-time notifications for transactions including the amount spent, merchant name, and remaining balance, delivered within five seconds.
Biometric authentication for logins using fingerprint and facial recognition, ensuring user-friendliness and accessibility across devices.
Automated monthly breakdowns categorizing transactions by merchant types, with a visual dashboard and personalized budget-setting features.
System must comply with PSD2 regulations, particularly around strong customer authentication for payment initiations and sensitive account access.
All customer financial data must be stored and processed within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
Any new credit or lending features must align with the Central Bank of Ireland's regulations on consumer protection and responsible lending.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the transition.
